name: click-to-view-media
description: Blur images and videos until clicked, with YouTube ad mute/skip. Chrome and Firefox for Android builds.

scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 lint --source-dir=dist/firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 build --source-dir=dist/firefox --artifacts-dir=web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.run:android: npm run build:firefox && npx --yes web-ext@10.8.0 run --source-dir=dist/firefox --target=firefox-android --firefox-apk=org.mozilla.firefox_beta
